THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, Nalaka Jude Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands, do hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the lands described below are needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

The allotments of land depicted in below names and extents in the Advance Tracing No. MN/MNN/2022/322 dated 09.03.2023 prepared by the Surveyor General situated in the Village called Olaithoduvai in the Grama Niladhari Division
No. MN/60 of Olaithoduvai in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Mannar Town of Mannar District in Northern Province and bounded as follows:

01. Lot 'A '– Olaithoduvaikaani– Extent: 1.3988 Hectares North: Olaithoduvaikaani (Claiment Not Known); East: Olaithoduvaikaani (Claiment Not Known), Path and Lot B; South: Lot B, Path and Olaithoduvaikaani (Claiment Not Known); West: Olaithoduvaikaani (Claiment Not Known).

02. Lot 'B' – Not Mentioned– Extent: 0.0501 Hectare North: Lot A, Olaithoduvaikaani (Claiment Not Known) and Path ; East: Olaithoduvaikaani (Claiment Not Known) and Lot C; South: Lot C, Moondrupani Thennan Thoddam
